en: Added support for `timeouts.upstream_ttfb_ms` on the Claude apps gateway's Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and other cloud upstreams: a value you set now limits how long a stream may take to start there, after which it fails over or gets a 502
zh: Claude 应用网关的 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 及其他云上游新增 `timeouts.upstream_ttfb_ms` 支持：设置该值后，会限制流在该上游开始前的等待时长，超时则回退或返回 502
